name: GitHub Dark Colorblind
tagline: Green becomes blue and red becomes orange, everywhere, including in your terminal.
notes: Deuteranopia/protanopia variant. The substitution is not cosmetic: ANSI 2 and ANSI 1 are reassigned, so `git diff` in this theme prints additions in blue.

contrast_exempt.muted: ANSI 8 is GitHub's own dimmed-text value and dimmed text is supposed to recede; lifting it would mean shipping a terminal palette GitHub does not have (measures 3.57:1)
